title: EMEA Classic Cars monthly sales and quantity
description: Backend-neutral article scenario: EMEA Classic Cars monthly sales and quantity. The same scenario must be executed through sql_direct and xmla_emondrian.
business_domain: Orders, product lines and customer-country sales analysis
block_theme: wrong territory, wrong product line, bad grain
